spin_360.notes: Apple does not use an interactive 360 photo-spin viewer for MacBook Air. The product page uses scroll-driven CGI animation sequences, and offers AR Quick Look .usdz 3D models (CGI, rotatable on iOS only, e.g. /105/media/us/macbook-air/2025/.../ar/macbook-air-13in-midnight.usdz). All Apple product imagery for this product is CGI rendering, not photography.

collection_gaps: No classic user manual PDF exists for MacBook Air; MacBook Air Essentials is web/Apple Books only. Substituted: markdown captures of the guide's key hardware page (M3-era archived URL) plus the official Product Environmental Report PDF.

The M3-specific apple.com product page has been superseded by the M4 lineup at apple.com/macbook-air; no live M3 marketing page remains, so product-page video URLs specific to the M3 could not be recorded. Newsroom article (still live) substituted for launch-era marketing content.

Apple has published no official YouTube how-to for pairing generic Bluetooth accessories on a Mac (Apple Support channel searched: 'bluetooth mac', 'connect bluetooth', 'macbook air'). Official HTML guide URL recorded instead.

Store gallery side-view photos of the M3 Air (ports visible in marketing render) were not retrievable — gallery asset URL patterns 404 (3 patterns tried). Official guide port diagrams (left/right side with callouts) substituted; they show port positions authoritatively.
Newsroom hero images depict both 13-inch and 15-inch models together; Apple did not publish 13-inch-only newsroom shots for M3.
Tech specs page (en-us/118551) has been updated by Apple since launch (base memory now listed as 16GB; footnotes reference 2025/2026 software); launch-day base config (8GB) noted in tech-specs.md.
